common_hull.interpretation: Bulk fallout inside the surveyed footprint, including unsampled gaps; not total eruption volume.

model_domain.definition: Convex hull of all accepted measurement and bound locations; no vent or pseudo-points added.

volume.scope: Integral on the explicitly supplied regional geometry; no global integral.

joint_volume.interpretation: Conditional joint-surface intervals. Omit fitted-parameter and selection uncertainty. Mean-grid and Monte Carlo checks do not establish tail-quantile quadrature convergence.
